sn20.2:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyam paṃsum āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi || || 3
sn20.2:1.4: Katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yo cāyaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito || yā cāyam mahāpathavīti || || 4
sn20.2:1.5: Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idam mahā pathavī ||
sn20.2:1.6: appamattako yam Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito ||
sn20.2:1.7: saṅkham pi na upeti upanidhim pi na upeti kalabhāgam pi na upeti mahāpathavim upanidhāya Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito ti || 5
sn20.2:1.8: Evam eva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti ||
sn20.2:1.9: atha kho ete yeva bahutarā sattā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti || || 6
sn20.2:1.10: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || ||
